title: Peli Motto
description: Peli Motto seemed like she always ran Hangar 3-5 at Mos Eisley Spaceport, but no one could say for sure. She was a fair hand with a wrench, working on battered ships and refueling them for the credits. With a "capable" team of pit droids and other various models— including Rebel hero R5-D4 for a time—she was able to take on just about any job, big or small. She even rebuilt a Naboo N-1 starfighter for the Mandalorian after the Razor Crest was destroyed.
